name.value: iShares Core MSCI World ex Australia ESG ETF
name.note: Was the iShares Core MSCI World All Cap ETF until 8 Jun 2021, when it changed index and became the iShares Core MSCI World ex Australia ESG Leaders ETF (sources differ on 7 or 8 Jun). 'Leaders' was later dropped from the name; the date of that change was not found.

index.value: MSCI World ex Australia Custom ESG Leaders Index (AUD), unhedged
index.note: On 8 Jun 2021 the benchmark changed from the MSCI World Investable Market Index to this ESG index (BlackRock). Developed-market large and mid caps outside Australia, screened for ESG.

mer.note: Management fee as stated in the PDS

yield.note: BlackRock's '12m Trailing Yield' at 15 Oct 2026: income distributions with ex-dates in the past 12 months (1 Jul 2026 and 7 Jan 2026; 96.26 cents in total) divided by the latest NAV. Fact sheet: 1.34%.

franking.note: BlackRock's published 'Franking Level of distributed income' for the year ended 30 Jun 2026 (0.010255%), so effectively 0. Overseas shares carry almost no franking credits.

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception (first unit creation); listed on the ASX 28 Apr 2016
